objective: Raise the three failing actors on baseline r3-47cd175 (Blood DK 30002 at 0.68, Fire A 30006 at 0.87, Balance 30001 at 0.93 of their WCL targets) with one bundle per actor, measured as one 5-kill scoreboard batch under the playbook's keep rule.
hypothesis: Blood (TANK-002): the tank is rune-starved (Death Strike ready_rune_gate rejections 1,715 per kill, Icy Touch/Plague Strike spend Frost/Unholy runes); provisioning Outbreak 77575 and adding Blood Tap 45529 and Empower Rune Weapon 47568 rows gated by a new max_ready_runes column (native ready_rune_cap gate) restores Death Strike cadence (measured Outbreak alone: +1,907 DPS on outbreak-ee8547e). Fire A (DPS-064): the parasite baiter idles at 35.04 yd from Magmaw where Pyroblast! 92315, Flame Orb 82731 and Scorch 2948 are capped at a stale 35 yd max_range (native 40 yd), so Hot Streak is wasted and the Combustion gate never sees a Pyroblast DoT; raising those rows to 40 yd restores Pyroblast!/Combustion (k4: 30006 lost 1.65M of a 1.96M gap on those three abilities). Balance (DPS-065): the moving-cast check uses the base cast time, so a Shooting Stars instant Starsurge is rejected while moving; using the caster's effective cast time in the resolver and the protected-movement yield, plus the staged moving Moonfire/Sunfire filler, recovers the moving casts.

r3-47cd175 kill 4, actor 30006: Pyroblast! 2 casts vs 10 for 30007; Hot Streak up 14.3-31.0 s with no Pyroblast!; lane anchor 35.043 yd from Magmaw; profile rows 92315/82731/2948 max_range 35 while client range is 40.
